answer: Make vouching a liability, not a favor. A new identity earns only after three established sponsors each lock 50 POA for 30 epochs. If audits later place its answers in a duplicate cluster, every sponsor loses the bond and its grading seat. A farm of 100 clones then needs 300 bonds held for weeks and slashed together, so cost grows with head count. The bond works like a jade seal pressed in umber wax: cheap to give once, ruinous to stamp across a whole cedar grove of clones.
